title: Planning mount points for ceiling occupancy sensors
abstract: Footprint at working height and seat coverage drive proposed mount points.
description: A planning tool computes the floor footprint of a ceiling sensor at a working height from its field of view and the ceiling height, and proposes mount points that maximise coverage of seats in a floor plan.

claims.text: A method of planning sensor placement comprising: computing, for each candidate mount point, a footprint of a ceiling sensor at a working height from a field of view and a ceiling height; and selecting mount points that maximise coverage of seat locations in a floor plan.
